decision_question: Why does the strict-42 strategy remain below A+, and is the frozen paired-book gate aimed at the measured failure mechanism without reusing outcome labels?

verified_driver.finding: The strategy is profitable in aggregate but materially overconfident at entry; the market probability is closer to the realized outcome rate than the internal fair value.
verified_driver.interpretation: The internal fair value overstates confidence by 8.03 percentage points on executed candidates. Copying the market would remove the claimed edge, so the actionable need is a causal uncertainty filter that can reject unreliable model edges rather than another calibration blend.

payoff_geometry.interpretation: Profit factor alone is close enough that removing two average losses while preserving winner dollars would clear 1.20, but A+ requires the stronger preregistered effect: at least 90% winner retention and 30% loss removal, plus fee-aware unit economics, breadth, halves, burst, and tail gates.

chronology_and_concentration.interpretation: Loss count is not confined to one chronological half or one direction. The second-half failure comes from insufficient winner dollars relative to persistent full-loss events, not a simple one-sided label that can be removed safely.

mechanism_fit.fit_to_driver: Both outcome books are claims on one fully collateralized dollar. Large causal disagreement between their midpoint and depth-weighted microprice sums is therefore a market-state uncertainty signal that is independent of the terminal label and can veto an overconfident single-book edge.
mechanism_fit.why_no_strategy_change_now: The rule and all thresholds were frozen before forward scoring. Changing them while block 1 is collecting would invalidate the prospective test and create sequential-peeking bias.

external_research.title: Polymarket Positions & Tokens
external_research.verified_use: Each Yes/No pair is backed by exactly one dollar and equal pairs can be merged back to collateral, which supplies the complement identity behind the gate.

external_research.title: Polymarket Prices & Orderbook
external_research.verified_use: Displayed midpoint is not executable; a buyer pays the ask. This supports recorded-ask rather than midpoint unit economics.

external_research.title: Polymarket Fees
external_research.verified_use: Crypto taker fees use fee = shares * 0.07 * price * (1-price), rounded to five decimals; the scorer records and applies the per-market entry rate.

external_research.title: Queue Imbalance as a One-Tick-Ahead Price Predictor in a Limit Order Book
external_research.verified_use: Depth imbalance can carry short-horizon information, supporting a depth-weighted microprice as a state descriptor rather than a terminal-outcome guarantee.

external_research.title: The Anatomy of a Decentralized Prediction Market: Microstructure Evidence from the Polymarket Order Book
external_research.verified_use: The reported low agreement between public-feed and on-chain trade-direction inference reinforces keeping the active gate on contemporaneous book state; it does not rely on inferred aggressor direction.

decision.next_evidence: Score binary_complement_coherence_v1 exactly once after 750 unique terminal settlement-aligned conditions, then reject on any registered classification or fee-aware economic gate failure.
